  OKUKHONJISWA UHLELO

  - Asikho isitshalo kulolu hlelo esinesilinganiso sesivuno sokudla se-kg/m² esiqinisekisiwe, ngakho akukho
  kuqhathaniswa kwamakhilogremu okuboniswa.
  - Okt, Nov, Dis zinemisebenzi ehleliwe eminingi kunazo zonke — kubalwa imisebenzi, hhayi amahora.

  IZINQUMO OKUFANELE ZENZIWE

  - Hlola izidingo zangempela zasekhaya nezivuno ezirekhodiwe; ukuqhathaniswa kwesilinganiso akusona
  isiqinisekiso sokudla noma sensalela.
  - Hlola ukuthi ubani otholakalayo ngaphambi kwesikhathi semisebenzi eminingi sango-Okt-Dis, bese ukala
  umsebenzi ngamahora angempela.
  - Qinisekisa umkhawulo wokulahleka ngamarekhodi angempela ngaphambi kokubala isamba
  esingasetshenziswa.

  Indlela izamba ezibalwa ngayo

  Asikho isamba samakhilogremu esiboniswa ngoba lolu hlelo alunaso isitshalo esinesilinganiso sesivuno sokudla
  se-kg/m² esiqinisekisiwe.

Okthoba 2026 kuya ku-Septhemba 2027


  Indlela izamba ezibalwa ngayo (kuyaqhubeka)

  Isilinganiso esingatholakali asisona isivuno esingu-0kg. Bhala izivuno zangempela eshidini lerekhodi lenyanga.

  Kungakanani ongakwethemba kulolu hlelo

  Akekho uchwepheshe wezolimo ohlole lolu hlelo. Lwakhiwe kusuka ebalazweni lakho, kudatha yesimo sezulu
  nomhlabathi elinganiswa amasathelayithi namamodeli omhlaba wonke, naseziqondisweni zokutshala
  ezishicilelwe zaseNingizimu Afrika. Luhlanganiswe ngokucophelela nangenhloso enhle — kodwa luyisiqalo,
  hhayi umyalelo.
  Sebenzisa nokwahlulela kwakho kanye nalo. Ikhompyutha ayikwazi ukubona umhlaba wakho. Ayazi ukuthi
  amanzi ama kuphi ngemva kwemvula enkulu, ukuthi isithwathwa sihlala kuliphi ikhoneni, ukuthi yini
  engaphumelelanga lapha ngonyaka odlule, noma ukuthi umndeni wakho uzodlani ngokoqobo. Wena uyakwazi
  lokho.
  Isibalo somhlabathi yisona esingase sibe nephutha kakhulu. Esethu sivela kumodeli yomhlaba wonke efunda
  indawo ebanzi, futhi umhlabathi wangempela ungashintsha ukusuka kolunye uhlangothi lwensimu eyodwa
  kuya kolunye. Uma noma iyiphi inombolo lapha ibalulekile esinqumweni ozosebenzisa imali kuso, ukuhlolwa
  komhlabathi kuwukuphela kwendlela yokwazi. Ungalayisha umbiko wokuhlolwa bese uhlelo lwakhiwa kabusha
  ngokwezibalo zakho zangempela.
  Bonisa lokhu kumeluleki wezolimo wendawo yakho. Bazi isifunda sakho, imvula nezinambuzane zendawo
  ngendlela engeke yaziwe yimodeli, futhi bangalungisa ngemizuzu eyishumi lokho obekungakulahlekisela isizini.
  Akubizi lutho, futhi kuyinto ewusizo kunazo zonke ongayenza ngalo mbhalo.
  Lindela ukuthi okunye kulo kuzoba nephutha. Bhala lokho okutshalwe ngokoqobo nalokho okuvuniwe
  ngokoqobo. Isizini ngayinye oyibhalayo yenza uhlelo olulandelayo lufanele umhlaba wakho kangcono kunalolu
  — yilokho oluhloselwe kona.
  Izikhathi zokuvuthwa ezishicilelwe zezimo ezifanele ziyizikhala zokuhlela, hhayi izithembiso. Ngaphambi
  kokuhlwanyela noma ukutshala isitshalo esilandelayo kwenye indawo, qinisekisa ukuthi esangaphambili
  sesiqediwe nombhede awusenalutho ngempela; izitshalo zingavuthwa kamuva.

  Indlela lolu hlelo oluhlanganiswe ngayo

  Kusukela ohlelweni oluphakanyiswe ngo-Okthoba 2026. Okushintshwe ngesandla ngemva kwalokho
  akuchazwa lapha.
  Ukuhumushwa kwamanothi ohlelo agciniwe kuyimibhalo engakabuyekezwa. IsiNgisi sokuqala siyatholakala
  ngezansi kwenothi ngalinye elihunyushiwe. Amanothi angakahunyushwa ahlala ngesiNgisi.

  OKUFANELE UKUQAPHELE

  Ukuhlelwa kwezilimo zokuthengisa kuqhathanisa kuphela izilinganiso eziphansi ezicatshangelwayo zesisindo
  esisha nge-kg/m² ngomjikelezo ngamunye wesilimo. Akulinganisi inzuzo, umsoco, isidingo sabathengi noma
  isivuno sonyaka esiphezulu kunazo zonke; sebenzisa ulwazi lwakho ngabathengi namanani ngaphambi
  kokubekela izilimo indawo.

  OKUFANELE UKUQAPHELE (kuyaqhubeka)

  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: Commercial ranking compares conservative fresh-weight kg/m² per crop
  cycle only. It does not estimate profit, nutrition, buyer demand or a global annual maximum; use your own
  buyer and price information before committing land.
  Uhlelo oluncike emvuleni: isilimo sihlwanyelwa kuphela lapho inyanga ngayinye esikhula ngayo ithola imvula
  okungenani elingana nengxenye yokuhwamuka okulinganisiwe (umthetho we-FAO wesikhathi sokukhula,
  kusetshenziswa imvula yanyanga zonke yale ndawo; ukuhwamuka kulinganiswa ngezinga lokushisa ngendlela
  ka-Thornthwaite, engakulinganisela phansi ezindaweni ezomile nezinomoya). Imvula eyisilinganiso akuyona
  imvula yawo wonke unyaka — nisela ngesikhathi esomile uma ukwazi.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: Rain-fed plan: a crop is only sown where every month it grows gets rain of at
  least half the estimated evaporation (the FAO growing-period rule, using this site's monthly rainfall; evaporation
  estimated from temperature by Thornthwaite's method, which can under-estimate it in dry, windy places).
  Average rain is not every year's rain — water in a dry spell if you can.
  Inani labantu obondlayo alisetshenziselwa ukuqagela ukuthi utshale okungakanani. Uhlelo luzama zona kanye
  izilimo ozikhethile; indawo yakho esemephini, izikhathi zokuhlwanyela nokushintshaniswa kwezilimo kunquma
  ukuthi yini elinganayo.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: How many people you feed is not used to guess how much to plant. The
  planner tries the exact crops you chose; your mapped space, the sowing windows and crop rotation decide
  what fits.
  Izilimo zokumboza umhlabathi zivaliwe ekukhethweni kwezilimo, ngakho indawo ngayinye iyaphumula ngemva
  kwesilimo sayo sasehlobo esikhundleni sokumbozwa yi-broad beans noma i-oats ebusika.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: Cover crops is switched off in the crop mix, so each plot rests after its
  summer crop instead of getting a winter cover of broad beans or oats.

  IZINTO EZIKHETHWE YILOLU HLELO

  Asikho isilimo osikhethile esikwazile ukubekwa kulokhu — isikhathi saso sokuhlwanyela asifiki ngesikhathi,
  noma ayikho indawo yokulima emephini yakho enesimo esisifanele. Hlola isikhathi sendawo sokuhlwanyela
  noma ungeze isilimo ngesandla; lokhu akubufakazi bokuthi isilimo asikwazi ukukhula lapha.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: None of the crops you chose could be placed this round — either their
  sowing window does not come round in time, or no growing area on your map has the right shape for them.
  Check the local window or add a crop by hand; this is not proof that the crop cannot grow here.
  Hlola inyanga ngayinye yokuhlwanyela nesikhulu sendawo eseluleka ngezolimo — leli khalenda lihlolwe isilimo
  ngesilimo kuphela eKwaZulu-Natal.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: Check each sowing month with your local extension officer — this calendar
  has been checked crop by crop only for KwaZulu-Natal.
  I-Maize ayibekwanga ngokuzenzakalelayo: uhlelo lokusebenza lungalinganisa indawo esemephini, kodwa
  alukwazi ukudweba noma ukuhlola ibhulokhi le-maize elimpova yalo ithwalwa umoya. Engeza indawo yezilimo
  zokudla okuyisisekelo emephini, noma ungeze i-maize ngesandla ngemva kokuhlola ukuhlelwa kwemigqa
  yangempela.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: Maize was not placed for you: the app can measure mapped area, but it
  cannot draw or check a wind-pollinated maize block. Add a staple plot on the map, or add maize by hand once

  UMHLABATHI ONGANA KUHLWANYELA OKUSHA

  Inyanga yamanje ibingatholakali, ngakho iziphakamiso ziqala ngoJanuwari.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: The current month was unavailable, so suggestions start from January.
  Lezi zinyanga zokuhlwanyela zilandela ikhalenda le-KZN DARD lezindawo ezifudumele. Ngaphandle
  kweKwaZulu-Natal, ziqinisekise nesikhulu sendawo eseluleka ngezolimo.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: These sowing months follow the KZN DARD warm-area calendar. Outside
  KwaZulu-Natal, confirm them with your local extension officer.
  Munye kuphela umbhede okhululekile — ugcinelwe ukondla umndeni; engeza imibhede ukuze ukwazi
  nokubekela eminye ukuthengisa.

  some aside for selling.
  Inothi lokuqala lohlelo eligciniwe: PRIVATE {count}, {note}; $& <kept> 03.50 m²

  INDLELA LOKHU KUHLELWA OKWENZIWE NGAYO

  Alukho uhlelo lwezilimo oluzenzakalelayo olwenziwe ngoba ukuchelela okuthembekile akuqinisekiswanga futhi
  idatha yemvula nezinga lokushisa lanyanga zonke yale ndawo ayitholakalanga ukuze kuhlelwe isikhathi
  sokulima esincike emvuleni. Lolu hlelo lufaka ngamabomu imijikelezo yezilimo elandelanayo, futhi ilebula
  yemvula yesifunda ayifakazeli ukuthi leli pulazi lingazinika amanzi.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: No automatic crop plan was generated because reliable irrigation was not
  confirmed and this site's own monthly rainfall and temperature were not available to plan a rain-fed season.
  This engine deliberately packs successive crop cycles, and a regional rainfall label does not prove that this farm
  can water them.
  Asikho isilimo esikhethwe yilo muzi esinohlelo lwezikhathi oluqinisekisiwe lokuhlela okuzenzakalelayo.
  Buyekeza lezo zilimo ngesandla noma ukhethe esingahlelelwa izikhathi; uhlelo ngeke luqagele esizongena
  esikhundleni sazo.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: None of the crops this household chose has a verified schedule for automatic
  planning. Review those crops by hand or choose one the planner can schedule; it will not guess a substitute.
  Kukhethwe ukuvuna okumbalwa okukhulu: isilimo ngasinye sihlwanyelwa ngobuningi kanyekanye, bese
  ukuhlwanyela kwaso okulandelayo kuqala kuphela ngemva kokuphela kwalokho kuvuna. Akungezwanga
  ukuhlwanyela okuncane kwanyanga zonke.
  Inothi lohlelo lokuqala ngesiNgisi: A few big harvests was selected: each crop goes in as one big sowing at a
  time, and its next sowing starts only after that harvest ends. No small monthly sowings were added.
